workspace.description: The workspace whose Slack bot it is, by the slug list_workspaces answered; leave it out where the member belongs to one workspace alone.

notifications.description: Whether the bot writes the member, in Slack, the threads that wait on them; the member's own switch, which holds in every workspace.

defaultRepository.description: The repository an agent started from Slack works in where its message names none, as owner/name, one the workspace's GitHub reaches; null clears it.

channelId.description: The channel, by the id read_slack_bot lists it by.

member.description: true to put the bot in the channel, a public one alone; false to take it out, which forgets the channel's repository.

repository.description: The repository an agent started from this channel works in where its message names none, as owner/name, one the workspace's GitHub reaches; null clears it.

channel.description: One channel of the team to change.
